sanskrit: stasmātprajñānusārādahamapi bhavataḥ staumi kiṃciccaritramccitraṃ tadvanmayāpi svamativibhavataḥ stūyase tvaṃ na doṣaḥnānyastvattaḥ paro'stītyahamiha guruṇā tvāṃ svabhāvairavaiministarkopādhibhedaiḥ paramapuruṣa te tattvamadvaitametisvāghorabrahmavidyāviditaparapadaṃ brahma sa praiti vidvānyaḥ ko'pyekaḥ sa yogī jayati janimṛtī bho mahāmṛtyumṛtyostvaṃ ṣodhā bhinnamūrtiḥ paraśiva sa budho viśvarūpatvamīyātsvātmajyotirvilīnānvidadhati viduṣo yoginaḥ saiva muktiḥtvattejo'ntarnirūḍhā racayati jagatāmādimadhyāntakālānmṛtyuṃ vijñānadānātpraharati viduṣāṃ tanmahatvaṃ tvamevayena svātmanyanādau sakalavilasitaṃ te parāyāḥ sa bhedaḥsaptasrotovibhūtiṃ tribhuvanamayatāṃ tattvataḥ sarvaturyāmjñātvā muktaḥ sa yogī bhavati gatabhavastvatprasādānmaheśaye dhīrāstarkayeyusta iha janimṛtīrāpnuvantyaṅgabhāraiḥsvajyotiḥ satyamekaṃ jayati tava padaṃ saccidānandamūrtesarvātītaṃ vikalpagraharahitamajaṃ mānatarkādyagamyamkṛtyākṛtyarvihīnāḥ parapadavibhavaṃ tvāṃ prapaśyanti viśvammaccittasthaḥ prameyaṃ samupadiśa paraṃ mātṛkāvarṇarāśimśrutyā sārdhaṃ sa kena pravitatamatinā varṇyate te maheśadvātriṃśadraśmimukhyāḥ svakiraṇakaraṇavyāptaviśvairvibhāntinirdhāraścedvināśā na hi mativacasāṃ deva tasmātparastvamdhāreṣvantarghṛtaṃ yatpayasi tilacaye tailavadbhāsi hīśabrahmāntātmaprapañce vilasati na paro'stīti cetpārijātaḥheyopādeyabuddhyā bhava iti vihitaste mahāmāyayeśadhatse śailūṣavatte smarati na tu padaṃ śrīmahādevamūrte

sanskrit: dvitīyamtanvāno nirmamecchastvamiha vijayase viṣṇumāyāvibhūtebījākāraḥ svayaṃbhūriti kathayati te nāma viśvātmasṛṣṭeḥśrīśaṃbho viśvasṛṣṭirbhavasi nijamalatrayyupaproṣitātmāścaitanyā eva tasmātsthitiriti viditastvaṃ sahasrārkadīptesvecchāvasyāguṇāḍhyo'pyaguṇa iti vibho vastutaḥ stūyase tvanrāvirbhūtvā tvadaṅgaprakaṭanakṛtaye bodhasindustvamevaicchāśaktiskandharaśmiprakaraṇaṃ tṛtīyamhetutvena prabodhajvalana tava mahājñānaśaktiṃ vyanaktiprācuryeṇa pradīptaḥ paramaśiva tataḥ satyaviśvātmakastvamsaṃsāritvaṃ prasārya dṛḍhayati bhavataḥ satyatāṃ vedavidyāmutpādyaitatprapañcaṃ ghaṭayati tadidaṃ vyaśnuṣe svātmayoneprādurbhāvastadā tvaṃ bhavasi sadasadānandanāthaḥ paro'gramudrā nānāsvarūpāḥ prakaṭayati mudāhaṃkṛtisthāḥ pareśajñānaśaktiskandharaśmiprakaraṇaṃ caturthamtruṭyadbrahmāṇḍabindūnvikirati tava cettvaṃ śivātaḥ kriyātmāgāraṃ yadbrahmasattā jayati tava manorūpaviśvātmakatvambāhyākhyādarśanārthaṃ vimalaśiva tatastvaṃ hṛṣīkāśrayātmāsvātmānaṃ viśvarūpaṃ prakaṭayasi yadā tvaṃ tadā gocaraḥ syāḥstasmāttvaṃ lokamukhyo'dvayamiti rahitaḥ svaprakāśaprameyaḥstvatsaktā bījajātāḥ svaguṇamanusarantyeva te deva sattvātnānābhāṣākriyābhiḥ prakaṭayati tataḥ saiva te sāṅgavedāntvaṃ cedeko'dvitīyaḥ kramarahitamahāsaṃvidātmā maheśaḥvahnibradhnendukḷptaṃ paraśiva sakalaṃ vyaśnuṣe svātmanā tvamrātmāgnau brahmavidyāpariṇatamatibhiḥ śrīvibho hūyase tvam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00358 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svācāryo deśikendraḥ paramakhamugasi tvaṃ paraḥ śaṃbhurīśaḥsaṃjātāḥ sarvatastvaṃ prabhavasi manasā citranirmāṇamūrtekriyāśaktiskandharaśmiprakaraṇaṃ pañcamamkṛṣṇādhvārkenduyonirbhujagapatitanustvaṃ tataḥ kuṇḍalīśaḥbrahmānandapravāhāmanubhavasi parāmādisauṣumṇamūrtesārdhaṃ haṃsaḥ parasminmahasi khalu layaṃ praiti te prāṇasūtraḥnānārūpāśca sarvāyanapathikamahāspandakaḥ sa tvamevanirvāṇaḥ kṛṣṇavartmā bhavati tava mahāspandatāmetya śaṃbhomajjantyādyantahīnā yadi kṛpayati sā mocayenmṛtyubandhātkuṇḍalinīśaktiskandharaśmiprakaraṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhamstattadvarṇātmabhedairupadiśasi padaṃ śrīguro svasvarūpamrvaṃśairyantraiśca gātrairjaladharapaṭalaistvaṃ bravīṣi dhvanijñaḥsārasphārasvarūpaḥ puruṣa iti tataḥ so'kṣarātmādivarṇaḥnnānārāgānprabandhānadhivasati bhavānādinityasvarātmanvidyāvidyobhayātmā janayasi paritaḥ śrīmahāvarṇajātmanjñātā vargākṣarāṇāṃ paramaśiva janaistvaṃ tato vargajo'sisarvaṃ naśyadvinā tvāṃ paraśiva sahajaṃ varṇasaṃyogarūpamhaṃsaḥ so'haṃ tathā tvaṃ viramasi manasāmantare mantramūrteviṣvakprotapratīko dahasi bhavamaghaṃ duṣprabhāmantravahnaunānārūpāḥ parāgneḥ samajaniṣata te mātṛkāśaktibījātmātṛkāśaktiskandharaśmiprakaraṇaṃ saptamamkālāvasthāścaturbhiḥ pravidadhati yugairviśvabhūtairnidānaiḥkṣoṇyāṃ tvaṃ jīvamāyāguṇagaṇamabhito bhāsayasyaṃśumālinmārtaṇḍo raśmimadhyasthita iva parito bhāsi cidbhairavāgnebhaktāṃścānekabādhāñjhaṭiti vighaṭayantyātmabodhāgnijṛmbhaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00358 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: stotuṃ jñātuṃ samartho bhavati kavijanaḥ ko'tra mando nṛmātraḥṣaḍanvayaraśmivivekaskandhaprakaraṇamaṣṭamamśeṣastadrajjubandhastadupari pitṛbhūstatra cintyo rathī tvamdyotatpāśābhayāṅkairnijabhujaparidhaistvāṃ guruṃ śaṃbhumīḍetaṃ bhāsvadvyobhagabhoṃdaravidhṛtakarāṅguṣṭhamātraṃ prapadyesarvottīrṇātmatattveśvaramanalamukhaṃ tvāṃ guruṃ śaṃbhumīḍecchinnāvidyāsu lakṣyeḥ paramaśiva vibho tena mṛtyuṃjayastvamrviśvagrāsogramṛtyupratibhayadalinī tadbhavān mṛtyumṛtyuḥprāṇāste tatkapālaṃ hatavidhimukhasatpretacidrūpamīśabhīṣāsmāttvatsakāśādapara iva paro nāsti tenogravīraḥsthūlo'pi dhyānadṛṣṭestvamadhikatamasāṃ jyotiṣāmapyagamyaḥsatvaṃ yasyāntaraṅge nivasati sa śivastvanmayaḥ syānmaheśatasmātsvacchandalīlastvamiha vijayase mānasīṃ bhāvavṛttimsattāmātrāvalambītyamaranutapado nāsti devastvadanyaḥviśvāhaṃkārajṛmbhaṃ paramaśiva guruṃ tvāṃ bhaje mantrarājamyeṣāṃ teṣāṃ saparyā bhavati surakṛtabrahmatā yogitā cadhyāyāmi dhyeyamantaḥkaraṇasuniyatairyogibhiḥ śrīmaheśayogīndrā jīvasaṃghāstava caraṇabila yānti janmāntamadhyātrātmīyaiścitritāṅgaḥ śiva bhavatamasaḥ sūryabhāstvaṃ parastātboddhā svārthānanantānadhigatacaraṇaḥ sarvatastvaṃ śivo'sisaṃsārī kāmacārītyanuvadati jano yaḥ sa dhanyaḥ śiva tvāmdgātādhvaryuśca havyaṃ trividhahutavahastvāṃ vinā nāsti śaṃbhojñātvā ṣaṭcchaktibhistvāṃ paramaśiva mahāmṛtyumatyeti vidvānbhāṣā svārthairvibhānti triṇayana bhavato viśvamūrteḥ paraḥ kaḥviśvanyagrodhakadroḥ paramaśiva bhavān bījabhūto vibhāti
source_edition: Muktabodha M00358 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jāgartyātmaprabodhe śiva tava kṛpayā so'tra mṛtyuṃjayaḥ syātvyaktīkṛtyātmavarṇaiḥ prakaṭayasi paraṃ tattvamātmīyamagreśrīśaṃbho viśvasattā parataraviyati paiṣi nirvāṇapūjāmtpattisthityantabhūmiḥ sa bhavati jagadāścaryavāneva śaṃbhotsaṃtoṣārthe maheśa trikaraṇavimalajñānapūjāprasannāḥrmāyā saṃsārabhāvo racayati nitarāmātmabhogāya bhedamsaṃtuṣṭaḥ syāḥ kathaṃ tvaṃ paraśiva vimalajñānadugdhābdhiśāyinsṛṣṭā hṛlliṅgamūrteḥ kathamitarajalaiḥ syāttava snānamatrasyanye mithyaupaccārāstava vasanamahāsūtravandhānuleṣāḥsaṃvitpūjyeti puṣpāṇyamala śiva bhavatpūjanāya kriyantestvāṃ śrīcidbhairaveśaṃ paramaśivaguruṃ pūjayanti smarantyaḥrārādhyo yogibhistvaṃ kathamitarakṛtaistoṣyase śrīpareśaantaryāgopācāraparāmarśaprakaraṇamekādaśamnānāpātrāṇi bhūmyāḥ paraśiva bhavataḥ pūjanāya kriyantehālādadhyājyadugdhānyapi vidadhati te sūpahārāya śaṃbhosarvānandātmarūpaṃ paramaśivaguruṃ bhāsayatyaurvatejāḥhastyaśvādīnrathāṃste paraśivacaraṇādhyāsya dāsyaṃ vidhattesarvairvādyaprabhedadhvanibhiriha vibho nātha pūjāṃ karotisarvānirvācyasattāviyaduditapadaṃ śrīvibho viśvamūrtesvasvavyāpārapuṣpaiḥ paramaśivaguruṃ tvāṃ vibho pūjayantiśāntā dhyāyanti gāyantyapi paramaśiva tvāṃ mudopāsate canṛttairvādyaprabhedairvidadhati sumudaṃ te mahādeva śaṃbhorvāgarthavyaktabhāvātsakalamiha tanuṃ vyaśnuvāno vibhātinanyānindūḍumukhyānnibiḍatararucirdhvāntapūrāṃstavāgniḥbhūyādāgaḥ kṣamasva pravacanapaṭhitaḥ śrīvibho me prasīda
source_edition: Muktabodha M00358 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śāntiprakaraṇaṃ dvādaśamdahati vipadaḥ puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ durantabhavāṭavīmparamapadaṃ gatameva te prasādātmaheśa tvatsevāviditasuvivekāgnimahasājyotiḥpuñjaiḥ kimaparamahaṃ deva bhadraṃ samīheadya tvaṃ tribhuvanavāṅmanasyalabhyo nirbādhaḥ sakalapathaikagamyamūrtebhavantamadhidaivataṃ bhavavane jvalantaṃ svataḥkiṃ tu tvatpadapadmaniścalataradhyānaṃ samīhe vibhopuṇyaṃ pāpamagādvināśamiha me prāptaḥ prabodho vibhobhava bhavagataduḥkhaṃ chindhi cāgaḥ kṣamasvadṛṣṭvainaṃ bhītabhītaṃ śaraṇamupagataṃ trāhi māṃ deva mṛtyoḥvaktṝñśrotṝnpramātṝnnijahṛdayaguhābrahmasattaṃ nayantidehānte brahmapāraṃ paraśivacaraṇākāramabhyetya vidvānbrahmaprāptimavāpnuvanti paṭhanācchaṃbhormahimnastuteḥtejaḥ kīrtiṃ ca lakṣmīmabhilaṣitapadaṃ vyaśnute stotravīraḥsamastāḥ siddhirapyanubhavati gacchetparapadamstotraṃ paṭhedyo bhuvanādhipatyaṃ nityaṃ gurutvaṃ śivatāmupaitiaghorānnāparo mantro nāsti tattvaṃ guroḥ paramsarvāsāmupaniṣadāṃ durvāsā jayati deśikaḥ prathamaḥparaśaṃbhustutibodho jagadādhāro bhavetsadā dhīramraviriva jagatprakāśamticāturyājjagadgururbhavatiparaśaṃbhostavahṛdayaṃ satpātreṣu prakāśayetsadayam
